agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
December 13, 2011
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Nancy B. Jones, Retired Teacher
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Certificates for Incoming and Outgoing Commissioners
P2.
Proclamation Declaring Wednesday, December 14, 2011, "Moonlight Cultural Foundation Day" in the City of Vista.
P3.
Proclamation Declaring Thursday, December 15, 2011, "A Day Without a Bag" in the City of Vista.
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
C3.
Treasurer's Cash Report for Month Ended October 31, 2011 (CC)
C4.
2011 Supplemental Law Enforcement Services Fund (CC)
C5.
2012 Scheduled Commission, Committee, and Board Vacancies (CC)
C6.
Annual Authorization to Destroy Records (CC)
C7.
Conflict of Interest Code Update (CC)
C8.
Appropriation of Funds for the Encina West Influent Pipeline Breakage and Sewer Spill (CC)
C9.
Community Development Commission 2010-2011 Annual Report (CC/CDC)
1.
Adopt Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2011- , approving the 2010-2011 Annual Report.
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2011- , accepting the 2010-2011 Annual Report of the Community Development Commission of the City of Vista.
C10.
Amendment to Agreement - Janitorial Services (CC)
C11.
Occupancy Agreement with San Diego Aces Disc Golf Association (CC)
C12.
Lease Agreement for Operation of the Curbside Café at 307 Main Street (CC)
C13.
Appointments of Officials to Boards and Commissions (CC/BSD)
1.
Approve the appointment of Vista representatives to the various outside boards and commissions, and adopt the following:
a.
City Council Resolution No. 2011- , reappointing Councilmember Gronke representative and Mayor Ritter alternate representative to the Board of Directors of the North San Diego County Transit District Board (NCTD);
b.
City Council Resolution No. 2011- , approving the Mayor's reappointment of Mayor Ritter representative and Councilmembers Gronke and Aguilera first and second alternates, respectively, to the Board of Directors of the San Diego Association of Governments (SANDAG);
c.
City Council Resolution No. 2011- , reappointing Mayor Ritter and Councilmember Gronke representatives, and Councilmember Aguilera and Community Projects Director Putnam, alternate representatives, to the Board of Directors of the Encina Wastewater Authority;
d.
Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2011- , appointing Chairperson Ritter and Director Gronke representatives, and Director Aguilera and Community Projects Director Putnam, alternate representatives, to the Board of Directors of the Encina Wastewater Authority; and
2.
Confirm the Mayor's appointments to the agencies not listed above, but shown on Exhibit 5.
C14.
South Santa Fe Drainage Project (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2011- , approving a Fifth Amendment to the agreement with Tory R. Walker Engineering, Inc.
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2011- , amending the Capital Improvement Program Budget for FY 2011/12.
C15.
Agreement for Moonlight Amphitheatre Food and Beverage Services (CC)
C16.
Street Rehabilitation and Resurfacing Project Award of Contract (CIP No. 8155) (CC)
DISCUSSION
D1.
Selection of Mayor Pro Tempore (CC)
D2.
Skate Park Committee Report on Potential Skate Park Locations (CC)
D3.
Outdoor Smoking Lounges as an Accessory Use in Commercial Zones (CC)
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
